audit_fixes.title: False Dark-Background Inversion on Tight Handwritten Glyph Crops
audit_fixes.cause: normalize() only averaged top and bottom scanline pixels (y=0, y=h-1) and inverted whenever edge_mean < 128. Tightly cropped ascenders/descenders touching top/bottom borders pulled edge_mean below 128 on white paper, inverting ink and paper.
audit_fixes.fixSummary: Sample all 4 perimeter edges (top, bottom, left, right) with zero-division guard and require edge_mean < 96 before inverting.
audit_fixes.verifiedBy: Chunk 2 — Writer Profile Normalization & Averaging Gate

audit_fixes.title: False-Positive Numeric Disagreement on Trailing Sentence Punctuation
audit_fixes.cause: The numbers() closure kept "." and "," for decimals but did not strip trailing sentence periods (e.g. "1250." vs "1250"), triggering false numeric conflict warnings when one reader included a trailing period.
audit_fixes.fixSummary: Added .trim_matches(['.', ',']) after outer non-alphanumeric stripping so "1250." and "1250" normalize identically while preserving internal decimals like "48.5".
audit_fixes.verifiedBy: Chunk 1 — Independent Family Medoid & Numeric Consensus Gate

audit_fixes.title: Stale Block Answer Prefix Suppressing Re-Read Clarification Prompts
audit_fixes.cause: questions() checked a.id.starts_with("p{n}-b{index}-"), which suppressed new clarification questions on a block even after its content and block_digest changed during a contextual re-read.
audit_fixes.fixSummary: Compute the full block digest ID first (p{n}-b{index}-{digest[..10]}) and match exact question IDs so modified blocks are re-prompted.
audit_fixes.verifiedBy: Chunk 4 — Clarification Digest Guard & Context Re-Read Gate

audit_fixes.title: TrueType Binary Table Checksum & Unsorted Glyph Mapping Ordering
audit_fixes.cause: cmap Format 4 requires character code mappings in strictly ascending order; unsorted glyph arrays produce corrupt TrueType character lookups.
audit_fixes.fixSummary: Enforced ascending Unicode codepoint sort before building glyf, loca, hmtx, and cmap Format 4 tables, and verified 0xB1B0AFBA head checkSumAdjustment.
audit_fixes.verifiedBy: Chunk 3 — TrueType (.ttf) Binary Checksum & Contour Gate
